item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Calculate all six plans for stated usage","mechanism":"Evaluate usage against included allowances and charge rules before presenting comparable totals.","implementation":"Ask for storage, editors, guests, and exports—not income. Calculate mandatory add-ons and overages for all six plans on one billing basis.","check":"Fixture-test allowance boundaries and add-on dependencies; displayed totals must match independently calculated expectations. Mark unsupported usage explicitly.","risk":"Unspecified usage must produce an incomplete estimate, not a misleading total."},{"action":"Separate required costs from optional purchases","mechanism":"Explicit charge categories prevent required add-ons from appearing elective and optional extras from appearing unavoidable.","implementation":"Show base price, required additions, selected optional extras, and total separately. Leave optional extras unchecked; explain each requirement using stated usage.","check":"Toggle each optional extra: only its cost and dependent charges should change. Required charges must remain included and labeled.","risk":"Dependencies can make an otherwise optional purchase require additional charges."},{"action":"Align capabilities in an accessible comparison table","mechanism":"Consistent rows expose differences that similar headline prices conceal, without requiring visitors to remember separate cards.","implementation":"Keep all six plans visible with semantic headers. Include allowance, required-add-on, optional-extra, and unavailable labels for every capability; never rely on color.","check":"Give visitors two similarly priced plans and fixed usage; ask which supports it, each total, and which charges are optional.","risk":"Wide tables need keyboard-accessible scrolling and preserved screen-reader header associations."},{"action":"Preview costs when usage crosses a limit","mechanism":"Boundary previews reveal cost jumps and capability ceilings hidden by a single usage estimate.","implementation":"Offer a user-controlled usage increment. Display current and revised totals for all six plans, naming triggered charges or newly unsupported requirements.","check":"Test immediately below, at, and above every allowance boundary; verify totals and availability against structured rules using keyboard and screen reader.","risk":"Label previews as hypothetical scenarios, not predicted usage or affordability advice."}],"abstention_reason":""}
